0022600106.text: The 76ers (2-0, first in the Atlantic and first in the East) host the Milwaukee Bucks (0-1, 13th in the East and 1 game back in the Central) after a 2-0 start. In 2025-26 Philadelphia won all four meetings, most recently 126-106 in Philadelphia on April 12, 2026, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 season series. Out for Philadelphia are Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery) and Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), while Dean Wade (ankle sprain), Joel Embiid (rest; 18.5 points and 33.9 minutes per game this season) and Tacko Fall (quadriceps strain) are day-to-day and game-time decisions, and Milwaukee has no listed absences.
